scope: Shared immutable sizing payload validation only; preserve source/science/order/manual controls and local composition.
change: After original semantic digest validation succeeds, retain an instance-owned exact-string proof. Every read still decodes a fresh tree. Missing, changed, mistyped or absent proofs retain full original validation.
limitations: No producer-only bypass: numeric mapping keys may normalize into a different canonical order.
No global cache or retained decoded research tree. Private proof is local integrity evidence, not authorization or a security boundary against arbitrary in-process code.
Installation, generation loading and affected latency recovery remain separate.
patch_encoding: UTF-8 LF zero-context unified diff; git apply --unidiff-zero after exact-preimage review.

encoded.source:
def encoded(value) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
